<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex02032025-04-2512-31-25" status="finalized">gnyis pa pa mtshan nyid ni | yi ge'i cha las shes par byed de | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">slob dpon</rs> rang gi bshad pa <!--Ar chos skor p. 337--> ltar shes rab ni chos rab tu rnaM par 'byed pa'o <note type="gloss">don daM rtos pa'o</note> ||
         <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="49b8"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5611">'buM pa</rs> ltar na sgyu ma lta bu dang rab tu myi gnas pa gnyis kyi don shes pa'o || 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">ma hA</rs> ltar na don daM pa'i bden pa shes pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
